message:
Where a wedding budget usually goes:

• Venue & catering: 40–50%
• Photo & video: 10–15%
• Flowers & décor: 8–10%
• Music: 8–10%
• Buffer: about 5%

The biggest factor in total cost is guest count, because catering, bar, rentals and stationery all scale per person. Typical ranges, not rules.
